links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of LLM ophthalmic patient education responses
links.effect: Median Flesch Reading Ease was 33.6 for Perplexity, 41.3 for ChatGPT, and 43.6 for Gemini; Perplexity differed from ChatGPT (Holm-adjusted P = .003), Gemini did not (P = .42).
links.quote: Median Flesch Reading Ease differed between Perplexity and ChatGPT (33.6 vs 41.3; Holm-adjusted P = .003), while Gemini did not differ from ChatGPT (43.6 vs 41.3; Holm-adjusted P = .42).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the baseline readability, understandability, and actionability of patient education materials generated by three LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
